question: Which scientist suggested that the magnet must also exert an equal and opposite force on the current-carrying conductor?
solution:
The correct answer is __Andre Marie Ampère__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ampere had come up with the theory of Electromagnetism and also its relation with light.
 
• He suggested that the magnet must also exert an equal and opposite force on the current-carrying conductor.
 
• Electromagnetism:- Phenomenon where the flow of electric current in a conductor produced a magnetic field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
